_source: Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-24: frames at 0, ~2, then every 5-15 s, audio probe on two. Our own descriptions; shots approximate; words not counted (no transcript), so words are 0.

hook.firstFrame: satellite relief India from above, no text

shots.picture: camera lands on one state, it lights up; a die-cut photo of a singer stands on it with a name tag
the same move repeats state by state: fly, light up, cut-out photo, name tag
pull back to all of India with every visited state coloured

ending.cta: which state is your favourite singer from (title)

whyItWorks: every viewer waits for their own state
one repeated move makes a long Short easy to follow
the coloured-in map at the end rewards watching to the end
